the ASGP- R mediates the clearance and thereby regulates the levels of glycoprotein ligands in plasma that terminate with sialic acid α2,6-galactose.
the ASGP receptor mediates the clearance from the blood of glycoprotein ligands terminating with Sia α2,6Gal.

understanding how the ASGP-R regulates levels of plasma glycoproteins terminating with terminal Gal, GalNAc, or Siaα2-6Gal.
understanding how the ASGP-R regulates plasma concentrations of glycoprotein ligands.
the role of the ASGP-R in regulating the levels of plasma glycoproteins terminating with sialic acids.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the asialoglycoproteins are cleared by receptor-mediated endocytosis and that the receptor mediates clearance of glycoprotein ligands terminating with sialic acid alpha 2,6-linked to galactose.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the ASGP receptor mediates the clearance and thereby helps maintain plasma levels of glycoprotein terminations with GalNAc, Gal, Siaα2-6Gal and GalNAcα2-6Sia.
the ASGP- R is a receptor that regulates levels of plasma glycoproteins terminating with Sia α2,6Gal.
the ASGP- R is a receptor that regulates levels of glycoprotein in the circulation.

the ASGP receptor mediates the clearance from the blood of glycoprotein that terminate with Sia α2,6Gal.
the ASGP receptor is not a single, simple glycan receptor, but a complex, multifunctional receptor that regulates the plasma levels of many glycoproteins.
